compatibilityPatch.before: const browser = await puppeteer.launch({ executablePath: chrome, headless: true });
compatibilityPatch.reason: Allow the existing ephemeral GitHub Actions Chrome environment to launch; no rule, selector, severity, finding, or scope is modified. Source files stay exact and patch applies only to a build copy.

decisions.staticTarget: Explicit dist directory, every CSS and both HTML files
decisions.renderTarget: Eight HTTP URLs only, no file:// fallback
decisions.moduleQueryPatch: Not applied: URL-only render avoids the upstream shell-detection limitation

gates: All upstream gates are retained. Current FAIL or REFLEX makes CI exit 1. Incomplete coverage, internal errors, missing render or incomplete kept comparison makes CI exit 2.
